name: .NET SDK Portable Updater
shortDescription: Install the .NET SDK on a machine you have no administrator rights on. Sets DOTNET_ROOT and PATH, prunes old SDKs, verifies SHA-512.
description:
Install the .NET SDK on any machine — including one where you have no administrator rights.

Locked down by corporate policy, not allowed to change the machine PATH, or a borrowed lab computer: this tool covers all three.

What it does
Reads Microsoft's release index directly, picks the right SDK for the channel you asked for, downloads the archive that matches your CPU, verifies its SHA-512 against the hash Microsoft publishes, unpacks it, then sets DOTNET_ROOT and prepends the folder to your own user PATH.

How it differs from Microsoft's dotnet-install.ps1
The official script does install the SDK at user scope, but you still have to set DOTNET_ROOT and edit PATH yourself, and superseded SDK folders are left behind forever. This does all three, and refuses to install a channel that is out of support.

Privileges
User scope only. It never touches machine-level environment variables and never asks for elevation.

Xác minh SHA-512 so với hash chính thức của Microsoft trước khi giải nén.
Kiểm tra chữ ký Authenticode của dotnet.exe sau khi cài xong.
Tự nhận diện kiến trúc: x64, x86, ARM64.
Chọn kênh LTS, STS, hoặc một major.minor cụ thể.
Từ chối bản preview và kênh đã hết hỗ trợ.

Ctrl+C dọn file tải về tạm, không để lại bản cài nửa vời.
Một file .exe 59 KB, không cài, không gỡ.
Lưu ý: file chưa ký số. Windows SmartScreen sẽ báo khi mở lần đầu — chọn Thêm thông tin rồi Chạy dù sao.

shortDescriptionEn: Excel blocking macros in .xlsm files? Adds the folders you pick to Trusted Locations, with dry-run preview, undo, audit log, and live trusted-locations list. No hardcoded branding, cross-platform launchers, no admin rights needed.
descriptionEn:
Run this file to make your Excel workspace stop blocking macros.

Excel blocks macros and files arriving from internal shares and mapped drives by default. Editing the settings by hand means nobody remembers what was changed, and the guides you find online switch off Protected View entirely. This script only adds the folders you pick to the trusted-locations list — exactly where trust is needed, without widening the attack surface.

v4.4 highlights:
- Cross-platform launchers: Windows (.bat/.ps1), macOS (.sh/.command), Linux (bash)
- ANSI escape codes fixed (PowerShell $ESC = [char]27)
- No hardcoded branding: descriptionPrefix in .ini (default "Excel Trusted Locations Tool:")
- PowerShell /auto bug fixed; /undo CLI support added
- Trusted-locations list shown after every add/delete with [tool]/[legacy]/[other] tags
- Runtime artifacts (.log, .snapshot.reg.*) excluded via .gitignore

WHEN YOU NEED IT

- Opening a .xlsm or .xlsb at work reports that macros are disabled
- Files on a mapped drive (Z:, or a network path) open blocked
- You do not want to edit Excel Options by hand or drop Protected View

WHAT THIS TOOL DOES

1. Adds the folder you choose to Excel Trusted Locations
2. Enables Trusted Locations for the Excel version installed
3. Cleans entries carrying this tool's own fingerprints, including the ones older releases left behind
4. Records every action to a log for later review
5. Shows live trusted-locations list after every operation

WHAT THIS TOOL DOES NOT DO

- Does not create macros
- Does not disable Protected View, unless the ini says disable-network
- Does not trust Downloads or Temp automatically
- Does not delete files or folders permanently
- Never removes entries an IT administrator configured

SAFETY MAP: FOUR GATES

Gate 1, system directories are blocked. C:\Windows, C:\Program Files, C:\Program Files (x86) and everything underneath them. Choosing any of those is refused outright, even with /yes.

Gate 2, Downloads is never trusted automatically. Downloads is where malware is most often delivered. Trusting it means every .xlsm dropped there runs macros immediately, including files sent by strangers. A silent run refuses completely; an interactive run shows a red warning and requires you to type y before it continues.

Gate 3, network drives are asked for one at a time, default no. Every mapped drive found is asked about separately, and the default answer is no. Only autoTrustMapped=1 in the ini skips the prompt, and that is a choice you explicitly own.

Gate 4, Excel must be closed. Excel writes back its security settings on exit, so any entries added while Excel is running get overwritten. The tool detects EXCEL.EXE and refuses to run if it is still open.

OPERATION MODES

Auto mode (from .ini): Create trusted_locations_excel_safe.ini with a [TrustedLocations] section listing paths. Run the launcher with /auto. Great for silent deployment.

Drive mode: Pick a drive letter (D:, E:, ...). The tool scans common folders and asks about each one. Default answer is NO — you stay in control.

Folder mode: Pick a specific folder containing your .xlsm files. The tool auto-detects the installed Excel version (16.0, 15.0, 14.0, 12.0) and writes to the correct registry key.

LIVE TRUSTED-LOCATIONS LIST (v4.4+)

After every add/delete (including dry-run), the tool displays the current Trusted Locations list with tags:
- [tool] — entries added by this tool (SV_ prefix or matching Description)
- [legacy] — entries from older versions of this tool (Trust_* with old Description)
- [other] — entries from IT admin or manual setup

This makes it trivial to audit what the tool manages vs. what your IT department manages.

UNDO & SNAPSHOT

Before every real run, the tool snapshots the registry keys it will touch. Use /undo to revert the last run, or run the generated undo helper file. The audit log records how many entries were added, removed, and left intact.

name: Spark Capacity Tester
shortDescription: Detect fake USB drives and check the real capacity of USB sticks, SD cards and disks.
description: Spark Capacity Tester checks the real capacity of USB drives, SD cards and disks. It returns clear PASS or FAIL results: a genuine drive reports its labeled capacity, while a counterfeit drive reports a much smaller real capacity. Portable Windows build, no installation required.
features: Quick Size Test — check 1GB sample on large drives
Full Free Space Test — verify actual remaining capacity
Auto-detects bad sectors and real capacity
USB 2.0/3.x, Type-C, SD, microSD support
TCT_ERROR reports with CRC and speed data
No .NET runtime required
No Administrator rights needed
requirements: Windows 10/11. File EXE đã đóng gói runtime nên chạy được ngay trên máy chưa cài .NET. KHÔNG cần cài thêm gì. Dung lượng tải về khoảng 111 MB.
